document.title: Isolated pgRDF qualification fixture observed on 2026-09-14
document.canonical_text: At the recorded observation time, a task-owned Docker fixture used the pinned pgRDF 0.6.34/PG 18.6 image on loopback 127.0.0.1:59861.
